title: Honey Bee Restoration
summary: As part of its livelihood development initiative, Rotary Public Charitable Trust of Bombay Airport facilitated the procurement of 50 Cerena Indica honeybee boxes (without bees) and 50 steel stands for beehives.
description: As part of its livelihood development initiative, Rotary Public Charitable Trust of Bombay Airport facilitated the procurement of 50 Cerena Indica honeybee boxes (without bees) and 50 steel stands for beehives. The purchase was made through One Bee Organic LLP, Vadodara, with the materials designated for delivery to Sandeep Hadbal at Kawale, Palghar. The contractor directly paid the supplier for the procurement to support additional beekeeping capacity.
